sloka: स तैः परिवृतस्सर्वै राक्षसैर्घोरदर्शनैः ।आगच्छत खरः शीघ्रं दण्डकानकुतोभयः ।। ७.२४.४१ ॥
transliteration: sa taiḥ parivṛtassarvai rākṣasairghoradarśanaiḥ ।āgacchata kharaḥ śīghraṁ daṇḍakānakutobhayaḥ ।। 7.24.41 ॥

translations.english: Surrounded by all those Rakshasas of terrible appearance, Khara quickly and fearlessly came to the Dandaka forest.
